book.name: 1 Korinto
book.title: A Mugaana Buk anun Paaulo karom a taara Korinto

content: Koku a taara na nurnur diat ung diat balet ut u ra naagagon
Baa raa kon muaat, anuna ta mawaat karom ta tepaana u ra nurnur, kup aawa maa in loi karom diat baa pa diat nurnur, kupi diat a naagagoni, ma wakir karom a taara anun God?

Lelawaai, pa muaat nunurai duk naa a taara anun God diat a naagagon a rakrakaan buaal? Ma baa muaat a naagagon a rakrakaan buaal, i lawaai maa pa muaat pet laar paai kupi muaat a wakado a kum kinkinalik na mawaat?
Lelawaai, pa muaat nunurai duk naa namur daat a naagagon a kum aangelo? Ma baa lenmaa, i lawaai maa pa daat pet laar paai kupi daat a wakado a kum utnaa ko ra lalaaun mi?
Io, baa anumuaat ta kum mawaat ko ra lalaaun mi, kup aawa maa muaat loi karom diat baa a taara na nurnur pa diat ru pa diat, kupi diat a naagagoni?
Iaau piri lenmi karom muaat kupi muaat a wawirwir uni. Lelawaai, pa te kon muaat i manaana kupi in paam a naagagon u ra kum mawaat naliwan taa ra kum tatena liklik u ra nurnur?
I lawaai maa ta tena nurnur in ben taa balet raa tenalik u ra nurnur karom diat baa pa diat nurnur, kupi diat a naagagoni?

A mangamangaan mi muaat murmuri baa muaat ung muaat balet ut u ra naagagon, i wapuaanai naa muaat aa puka. I lawaai maa pa muaat maadek wa diat maku baa diat paam aakaina karom muaat, ma diat walong muaat?
Iaku, muaat a taara na nurnur, muaat ut muaat paam aakaina karom muaat, ma muaat walong wetwetalaai muaat.

Lelawaai, pa muaat nunurai naa diat baa diat paam aakaina pa diat a kale a mataanitu anun God? Koku muaat waruga muaat ut. Maa diat baa diat paam a kum paamuk na mangamangaan, diat baa diat lotu karom a kum taabataaba, diat baa pa diat ru a kini na tinaulaa, diat baa a kum paamuk na muaana baa diat wiura panindiat, in muaana baa diat taulaa balet ma in muaana,

a kum tena walong, diat baa diat nemnem kup a kum utnaa baa diat a tadaaru mai, a kum tena ininim, diat baa diat pir aakaka a taara, ma diat baa diat maangluraa paa a utnaa baa wakir anundiat, diat raap maa pa diat a kale paa a mataanitu anun God.

Raa taara kon muaat, namuga muaat laana paam a kum mangamangaan mi. Iaku, u ra iaa ra Tadaaru Iesu Kaarisito, ma u ra Nio ra nundaat God, God ia gi agomgom pa muaat ko ra numuaat kum aakaina mangamangaan, kupi muaat anuna taara, ma ia watakado ta muaat kupi in waatung muaat naa muaat takado.
Daat a wangaala paa God ma ra panindaat

Kaduk te in piri lenbi, “A kum utnaa raap i koina ku baa ang paami.” Iaku wakir a kum utnaa raap i waraaut iaau. A kum utnaa raap i koina ku baa ang paami, iaku pang maadek paa ta utnaa kupi in naagagon iaau.

Ta taara diat piri kaai lenbi, “A utnaa na winangaan kup a balaandaat, ma ra balaandaat kup a utnaa na winangaan.” Iaku God in kamaar wa diaar raap. A panindaat wakir kup a paam a kum paamuk na mangamangaan, pate, kup a Tadaaru ut, ma a Tadaaru kup a panindaat.
U ra dekdekin God ut i watur paa balet a Tadaaru ko ra minaat, ma daat kaai in watur pa daat balet.
Lelawaai, pa muaat nunurai duk naa a kum pakpakaana panimuaat diat a kum pakpakaan Kaarisito ut? Lelawaai, ang kanaawa paa duk ta kum pakpakaan Kaarisito ungaai ma ra paamuk na tabuan? Painte mulu!
Lelawaai, pa muaat nunurai duk naa ia baa i ki ungaai ma ra paamuk na tabuan, diaar raa panindiaar maku ma ra paamuk na tabuan? Maa a Buk Taabu i piri lenbi, “Rudi diaar a raa maku.” Tur 2:24
Iaku ia baa ia paraap u ra Tadaaru, diaar raa niondiaar ku ma ra Tadaaru.

Muaat a waan ingen ko ra kum paamuk na mangamangaan. A kum aakaina mangamangaan ingen baa te i paami, pa diat ki u ra panina. Iaku, baa te i paam a kum paamuk na mangamangaan, i paam aakaina u ra panina ut.
Lelawaai, pa muaat nunurai naa a panimuaat ia a ruma anu ra Takado na Nion? A Takado na Nion baa i ki un muaat, God ia tabaara ta muaat mai. Muaat ut wakir anumuaat,
maa God ia kul pa muaat ma ra ngaatngaat na winekul. Io, muaat a wangaala paa God ma ra panimuaat.
